descriptions.d24j_acquire_slot_8017f6ec: Returns 0x80004005 when no slot of the 204-byte pool is free; otherwise prepares the resource when needed, pops a free index, retains the slot, stores it in the caller's handle, binds it to the resource and group (255 selects the default group), counts the kind and adds the count on success, increments +112 and returns the bind status.
